name: Ekinciler Demir Celik
summary: Ekinciler Demir ve Celik Sanayi A.S. specializes in producing steel products primarily for the construction industry. The company leverages a Monoblock System to achieve precise rolling geometry and dimensional accuracy in its output. Furthermore, it employs a Thermex QST Heat Treatment System to enhance the strength and ductility of its steel bars. For efficient processing, an IR Camera-based Automatic Bar Counting System is utilized, complemented by automated tying and hairpin systems for accurate bar counting and packaging. Established in 1983, the firm operates from its base in Maslak, Turkey.
